title: Walk On Kickballs
description: This is a handy dandy resourcepack to replace most walking and breaking sound effects for common materials like sand, wood, ect. with kickball sound effects!
body:
# Purpose:
Adds kickball sounds for all hitting/walking/breaking sounds of game materials.
